svg.text: Every layer reads the detected ProjectLayout and runs in the project's own virtual environment. No layer contains a path to any particular application.
.zip archive · GitHub / archive URL · directory on disk · uploaded stream
check — is this project in scope? (no model calls)
decides what runs, in what order
RunReport — one object the app, the CLI and the benchmark all read
before / after suite snapshots · per-test repair records with cause, strategies and attempts · coverage before/after · mutation score before/after
tokens, cost and duration · exported as JSON and CSV, or the repaired project as a .zip
Green = new in v2 or rewritten for it. The three green agents replace v1's single repair prompt; guards is what stops a "fix" that passed by deleting the assertion.
Grey = v1 capability kept and re-pointed from source_files/InsuranceApp_Modified to the project that was uploaded.
